name: Fearmonger raises Taldaram's Torment's tick rate and cost by 30% (#1033)
contract: Fearmonger 501132 carries two ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) effects on classmask (0,0,2097152), the same 8-rank Taldaram's Torment mask as #577/#981: MiscValue 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME) BasePoints -31 (real -30%) and MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) BasePoints 29 (real +30%). AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) applies SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME to the periodic amplitude only at aura-application time, so recasting Torment on the same, still-active target only refreshes its duration rather than recomputing the tick rate; two separate dummies (one cast before, one after learning Fearmonger) isolate a fresh application each, with a wait between the two casts to clear the caster's global cooldown. SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST generically and needs only a query. 802580 (level 56) is the rank a level-80 character owns.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Torment is applied to the baseline dummy
Fearmonger raises the power cost by ~30%
Clear the global cooldown from the first cast
Torment is applied to the boosted dummy
Fearmonger speeds up a fresh application's tick rate to 2100ms
The already-active baseline dummy keeps its original tick rate
